what_was_done: Relaxed the scanner gate in src/core/pipeline/nodes/collector.py to not filter candidates for missing catalyst, risk, invalidation at scanner stage.
Removed the deterministic market_scan bypass check from src/core/pipeline/nodes/agent.py, enabling Bob (the LLM) to reason over scan results sovereignly.
Adapted test_market_scan_result_finalizes_without_reentering_tool_loop in tests/test_agent_market_scan_loop.py to mock LLM gateway completion and assert output propagation.
Adapted test_candidate_gate_allows_missing_risk_and_invalidation in tests/test_market_scan_candidate_gate.py to verify relaxed gate criteria.
Ran the entire test suite of 986 tests, achieving 100% pass rate (986/986 passed).
Performed manual verification of the API stream endpoint using Invoke-RestMethod and confirmed that agent_called=true and candidate gate allows raw scanner candidates to pass to Bob.

manual_verification.result: Success: agent_called=true, candidate_count=5, top candidate EXEL generated a decisive study order with Bob's reasoning.
